offers.itemCostNote: $26.18 is a Labor Day sale price ending 2026-09-07 against a $55.70 compare-at. Re-read after that date - if it reverts, recompute every margin before selling on.

US.source: Read from the AliExpress listing 2026-09-01 with ship-to United States, USD: method 'AliExpress Selection Standard', $1.99, delivery Sep 10-14, 84.6% of orders within 11 days (<=8d 23.4%, 9d 24.4%, 10d 21.9%, 11d 14.7%), couriers SpeedX / GOFO / USPS. USPS is final mile only - this is a CHINA-DIRECT consolidated line, not a US warehouse. derivedFrom.note: Bundle row. Not an independently quoted supplier offer: every figure is the sum of the three component rows in this same file, because the kit is fulfilled as three separate DSers orders. stockOnSupplier is the MINIMUM of the three components, not a sum - the kit cannot be assembled more times than its scarcest part allows, and on 2026-08-25 that part is the cable organizer case at 19 units. The US shipping figure is lower than the CA one because the packing cube set ships free to the United States. Re-derive whenever a component row changes.

US.source: Derived from component US rows carried forward from the 2026-08-21 baseline; not re-read on 2026-08-25.

derivedFrom.note: Grey. Per-SKU cost was not read individually: the DSers product card quotes the whole product as USD 26.69-27.94 (shown alongside as CA$37.03-38.76), and every SKU here carries the TOP of the USD range. CORRECTED 2026-08-27: this row first carried 27.69, derived by dividing the CAD top by the 1.4 planning rate. That was wrong - the CAD figures are DSers own conversion at ~1.387, so back-converting them understated the supplier USD price by 0.25. The USD range is the primary figure and is now used directly. Stock is per-SKU and was read on 2026-08-27; the file-level supplierStockObservedOn refers to the carried-forward rows, not these.

CA.source: DSers Shipping info, AliExpress Selection Standard from CN, ship-to Canada: Free Shipping.
